Definition: feminine of the same as G2491; Joanna, a Christian:--Joanna.
BiblicalUsage: Joanna was one of the women who followed Jesus and served him with what they had. In Luke 8:3 she is named among the women who ministered unto him of their substance, the wife of Chuza, Herod's steward, and in Luke 24:10 she is among the women who tell the apostles the tomb is empty.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Joanna's story is the quiet backbone of the Gospels: she gave her money to the ministry, and she was one of the first to carry the news of the resurrection.
